items.raw_excerpt: El alcalde de Arica, Orlando Vargas, comentó en El Diario de Cooperativa las dificultades que ha enfrentado la ciudad en medio del sistema frontal que afecta al norte del país. La autoridad destacó que debido a la presencia de una garúa persistente se han provocado desprendimientos en caminos y en el Morro de Arica, situación que también ha llevado a la suspensión de clases por esta jornada.
items.summary_en: A weather system brought persistent mist to Arica in northern Chile, causing landslides on roads and at the Morro de Arica. Local officials announced class cancellations due to the dangerous conditions. The mayor highlighted the difficulties the city has faced during this weather event.
items.summary_ko: 칠레 북부 아리카에 강한 안개가 내리면서 도로와 모로 데 아리카에서 산사태가 발생했다. 시 당국은 위험한 상황으로 인해 수업을 중단한다고 발표했다. 시장은 이번 기상 현상으로 시가 겪고 있는 어려움을 강조했다.
items.title_en: Persistent mist causes landslides and class cancellations in Arica

items.title_original: Garúa persistente, desprendimientos y suspensión de clases: La afectación en Arica por sistema frontal

items.raw_excerpt: A case of West Nile virus has been detected in a Dutch blood donor in the first infection of its kind for six years. The donor, who lives in Utrecht province, is though to have contracted the virus in the Netherlands, as they have not been abroad recently, the public health agency RIVM said. The virus was confirmed after the patient reported mild symptoms of West Nile fever. Blood bank Sanquin subsequently carried out laboratory tests on a number of...
items.summary_en: A blood donor in Utrecht province tested positive for West Nile virus. It is the first case in six years where the infection was caught inside the Netherlands. The donor had mild symptoms and has not travelled abroad recently.
items.summary_ko: 위트레흐트주의 한 혈액 공여자에게서 서쪽 나일 바이러스 양성 반응이 나왔다. 6년 만에 네덜란드 내 감염 사례가 확인된 것이다. 공여자는 최근 해외 여행 이력이 없으며 증상은 경미한 것으로 알려졌다.

items.raw_excerpt: Limburg brewery Alfa has won one of the top prizes at the World Beer Awards for the second time. The family firm, based in Thull, was awarded the title of World’s Best Classic Pilsener for Edel Pils, which previously won the honour in 2021. It was one of four Dutch beers to win a Gold award at the annual festival in the English city of Norwich, along with Grolsch’s Cal and Herfstbok and the Gouverneur Superieur Pilsener made by another...
items.summary_en: A family brewery in Thull, Limburg won the World's Best Classic Pilsener title at the World Beer Awards. Their Edel Pils beer also won the same top prize in 2021. It was one of four Dutch beers to receive a gold award at the festival in Norwich, England.
items.summary_ko: 네덜란드 림부르크 지역 툴에 있는 가족 양조장 Alfa가 에델 필스 맥주로 세계 맥주 대상에서 최고 클래식 필스너 상을 받았다. 이 맥주는 2021년에도 같은 상을 수상한 바 있다. 노리치에서 열린 대회에서 네덜란드 맥주 네 종목이 금상을 받았다.
items.title_en: Dutch brewery wins world beer award for second time

items.title_original: Limburg brewery’s Pils scoops top global award for second time

items.raw_excerpt: Veículos em circulação cresceram 37 vezes em oito anos, saltando de 7,6 mil em 2016 para 284 mil em 2024. Programa vai ao ar às 23h na TV Brasil.
items.summary_en: Electric bikes in Brazil grew 37 times in eight years, from 7,600 in 2016 to 284,000 in 2024. The Caminhos da Reportagem program explores this rapid transportation trend. The episode airs at 11 PM on TV Brasil.
items.summary_ko: 브라질에서 전기자전거 등록 대수가 8년간 37배 증가해 2016년 7,600대에서 2024년 28만 4,000대로 늘었다. '카민호스 다 헤포타젠' 프로그램은 이 교통 변화를 집중 조명한다. 해당 회차는 TV 브라질에서 밤 11시에 방송된다.
items.title_en: Electric Bike Phenomenon Featured on Caminhos da Reportagem

items.raw_excerpt: El elenco nacional se inclinó por 3-0 ante las asiáticas en su segundo partido.
items.summary_en: Chile's women's field hockey team lost 3-0 to Japan in their second World Cup match. The team showed strong fighting spirit despite the defeat.

items.title_en: Chile's Hockey Team Shows Heart But Falls to Japan in World Cup
